#ai #futureofwork 

AI is changing everything and every industry is feeling it. From job security to the future of work, leaders are asking the same question: how do you stay relevant?

The On the Frontier series sits down with leaders to have candid conversations about what AI really means for your career, why this shift is bigger than just technology, and how the smartest leaders are adapting faster than everyone else.
title: How to adapt in the age of AI | Watch ep 1 of On the Frontier

author: Microsoft
description:
Every leader has an AI strategy. Ana White thinks most of them are starting in the wrong place. As Chief People & AI Enablement Officer at Lumen, she's leading AI transformation across her company on the conviction that the technology isn't where this begins the people are. She talks about leading through fear, building trust, and what has to come first if any of it is going to work. 

On the Frontier is a documentary interview series from Microsoft WorkLab, hosted by Matthew Duncan, who leads Microsoft's Future of Work initiative. Each episode sits down with a leader putting AI to work inside one of the world's most recognizable companies—Lumen, Levi's, Mastercard, EY, and DuPont—for an honest conversation about what's actually changing. Work and technology journalist Sherrell Dorsey joins across the season to connect each story to the bigger shift underway across the workforce. 

Follow Matthew Duncan on LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/matthewloysduncan/
